question: In the game of football, the distance between the goalposts is _________ whereas the distance from the lower edge of the crossbar to the ground is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7.32 m; 2.44 m.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Football**:-

 
 
• **It is also known as association football or soccer, is a team sport played between two teams of 11 players with a spherical ball. **
 
• It is played by 250 million players in over 200 countries and dependencies, making it the world's most popular sport.
 
• **In the game of football (also known as soccer), the distance between the goalposts is 7.32 meters (24 feet), and the distance from the lower edge of the crossbar to the ground is 2.44 meters (8 feet). **
 
• **These dimensions are specified in Law 1 of the Laws of the Game, which is published by the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).**
 
• The goalposts and crossbar must be made of wood, metal, or other approved material.
 
• They must be square, rectangular, round, or elliptical in shape, and they must not be dangerous to players. The goalposts and crossbar must also be white.
